purpose: Mechanically describe whether each frozen prospective watch fixed a numeric decision rule, a trial family and a design before its window opened. Reports gaps; never patches a frozen watch.

requirements.alternative_accepted_shape: review_rule with numeric bounds and requirement flags together with a declared metric list
requirements.applies_to: watches frozen at or after this registry version
requirements.rule: A watch that declares metrics without any numeric threshold can only be reviewed descriptively. It cannot be formally passed or failed, and a numeric rule written after the window opened must be labelled post-hoc and must not be applied to that window.

acknowledged_gap.reason: The watch declares eleven reporting metrics and forbids parameter, symbol, side, session, cost and start changes, but fixes no numeric threshold for any metric. It was frozen 2026-09-22T20:01:45Z and its prospective window opened 2026-09-23T00:00:00Z. No threshold may be retrofitted now: inventing one after the window opened is the failure this contract exists to prevent.
acknowledged_gap.consequence: The 2026-10-23 review reports the declared metrics and labels any added numeric rule as post-hoc. A numeric decision rule is required for the next versioned watch.

acknowledged_gap.reason: Declares metrics to evaluate and numeric data-volume gates (10 new independent batches and 5 new calendar days; 20 signals, 8 batches and 7 days for W3) but no outcome threshold. The numeric entries are dependence guards on how much evidence must accumulate, not rules on what the evidence must show.
acknowledged_gap.consequence: W1 and W2 reached their gates and were falsified in every predeclared cell on 2026-09-29; those identifiers are terminal. W3 remains accumulating.
